title: Headless chain: Gun Runners' Arsenal's set-up quest (NVDLC05MQ00, no stages: nDLCSetup 0 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 -> 5, then StopQuest), its vendor lines and its challenges' reward scripts; docs/handoff/mq-walkthrough-2026-10-27.md

actions.text: Gun Runners' Arsenal has one quest, NVDLC05MQ00, start-game enabled with no stages: its GameMode adds the add-on's weapons to the base game's form lists, protects the Gun Runners' Vendortron, moves the add-on's vendor containers beside their owners, waits until the player is out of Doc Mitchell's house, shows its two load messages and stops itself. The rest of the add-on is data (weapons, ammo, recipes, a perk), ten vendor lines that cap the vendors' caps, and 21 challenges whose reward scripts count stars on the quest's variables. A new game: the player starts in Doc Mitchell's house.

actions.label: set-up quest at the new game
milestone: set-up done up to the messages (nDLCSetup 4), the player still in Doc Mitchell's house
the Vendortron in its own faction
the Gun Runners' add-on container under the Vendortron's kiosk
Mick and Ralph's add-on container at their secret sales marker (Mick alive)

actions.text: The player walks out into Goodsprings: five seconds later the two load messages show (corner messages, no buttons) and the quest stops.

actions.label: milestone: set-up quest stopped after its messages (nDLCSetup 5)

actions.text: The Vendortron's shop line (GRA overrides it): its begin script caps the vendor container's caps at 8000, its end script opens the barter menu. Stand-in: travel to the Gun Runners by move_player; 9000 caps added so the cap shows.

actions.label: milestone: Vendortron's caps capped at 8000 by its shop line

actions.text: Gloria Van Graff's shop line (GRA overrides it): its begin script calls EnterTrigger on the add-on's Van Graff container, whose OnTriggerEnter caps Gloria's own vendor container at 7000 caps. Stand-in: move_player to the Silver Rush; 9000 caps added.

actions.label: milestone: Gloria's caps capped at 7000 through EnterTrigger

actions.text: The challenges: each reward script gives XP and counts one, two or three stars on NVDLC05MQ00's variables; three of a kind set the achievement flag. Stand-ins: the fights are kill with the player as killer, the player holding the weapon each challenge asks for (Talk About Owned: Benny with Maria; Sic Semper Tyrannis: Kimball with a one-handed pistol; Historical Propriety: Caesar with a combat knife; A Slave Obeys: Mr. House with the 5 Iron). These kills fail main quests on the way; the chain only reads the challenges.

actions.label: final: three two-star challenges, achievement flag set (NVDLC05MQ00 stopped, set-up 5)
